Medium roast

Hạ (Summer) pure-roast coffee

Caramel · Milk chocolate · Chestnut

Balanced, gently sweet and easy to drink, like a bright summer day. Your everyday cup.

From 120,000₫Contact

Flavor

Hạ is a medium roast that balances sweetness, bitterness and acidity. Expect caramel, milk chocolate and roasted chestnut with a round finish. It's the easiest-drinking of the four seasons.

How to brew it

  • Phin: 20–25g phin-ground coffee; great black or with condensed milk.
  • Espresso machine: 18g fine coffee for about 36g of espresso in 25–30 seconds.
  • Moka pot: slightly fine grind, low heat, take it off as soon as it starts to gurgle.

Step-by-step phin brewing guide →

Suggested bean ratio

50% Arabica · 50% Robusta for balance; more Robusta if you usually add milk.

Storage

Best within 60 days of opening. Keep the bag sealed, somewhere cool and dry, out of direct sunlight. Shelf life is 12 months from production; the roast date is written on every bag.
